summary.text: Kevin Hertel is a Democratic state senator from Michigan State Senate District 12 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 18 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Hertel lives in St. Clair Shores, Michigan, and graduated from Notre Dame High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Michigan State University.
His career experience includes working as a legislative analyst and as a special assistant to the office of the president for Blue Cross Blue Shield Michigan.
Hertel served in the Michigan House from 2017 to 2023, where his assignments included the Ways and Means Committee in 2019 and 2020, before moving to the Senate.

In 2025 and 2026 he chairs the Health Policy and Human Services Committee and is majority vice chair of the Veterans and Emergency Services Committee, and he also sits on the Appropriations, Energy and Environment, Transportation and Infrastructure, and Regulatory Reform committees.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, his answers described a focus on improving public education, protecting the Great Lakes and investing in infrastructure.
